steps.npc: Human. Are you here to trade ore? If not, I must point out that I have a lot to be getting on with.
This is Deepfin Point. Here, my workers and I have set up the finest mining operation you'll ever find. If you wish to do any mining yourself, you are more than welcome to.
Alternatively, perhaps you wish to trade ore? If not, I must once again point out that I have a lot of work to do.

options.text: Sounds like I'd best not disturb you.

steps.player: Sounds like I'd best not disturb you.
